note: Zgłoszenie z apki (24.11, 'Something else') do karty Ain Dubai: karta nie miała godzin ani ceny. Uzupełnione z oficjalnej strony aindubai.com (plan-your-visit, bilety).

set.description: Giant observation wheel on Bluewaters Island with enclosed cabins and views over Dubai Marina and the Palm. Tickets include up to 4 hours of parking on the island.
